privacy.title: Cookies and personal data
privacy.subtitle: Your data is isolated per workspace and never sold. Here's simply what's stored, and why.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses no advertising cookies and no third-party targeting cookies. An audience measurement tool records page views, time spent and an approximate country derived from your IP address, but only if you accept it in the banner shown on your first visit: it relies on a temporary session id that is cleared when you close the tab. Your choice is kept in your browser's local storage and you can change it by clearing this site's data. App pages (spaces, share links, dashboard) are never tracked.

sections.title: Local storage (localStorage)
sections.body: Your session (once logged in) and any share links you use are saved in your browser's local storage (localStorage), solely to avoid logging in again on every page. They are never sent to a third party. You can clear them at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser.

sections.title: Account and workspace data
sections.body: Your email address and your password (hashed) are required to create an account. The documents you upload, their indexed content and your conversations are stored on the server hosting the service (dedicated database and vector store), partitioned per workspace, and are never resold nor used to train an AI model. To generate an answer, read an image or index a document, the relevant text is sent to our AI inference provider, Mistral AI, a French company whose processing takes place within the European Union (see the Technical providers section below). Audio file transcription, on the other hand, runs on our own servers and is never sent to any third party.

sections.title: What you upload
sections.body: You remain responsible for the documents you upload and for the information you type into conversations. Before importing a file, make sure you are entitled to do so: do not upload documents belonging to a third party without their permission, and avoid particularly sensitive data (health data, identity documents, bank details, passwords) where it is not essential to your use. The content of your documents is processed automatically to answer your questions, and a share link grants access to an entire workspace: check what it contains before sending it, and revoke the link as soon as it is no longer needed. You can delete a document, a workspace or your entire account at any time.

sections.title: Contact form
sections.body: If you use the contact form, your name, email and message are kept so we can reply to you. This information is never resold or shared with third parties, and is never used for marketing outreach.

sections.title: Technical providers
sections.body: To operate, the service relies on a small number of providers acting as processors and bound by contract: a host (OVHcloud, servers located in France), an AI inference provider (Mistral AI, a French company, processing carried out within the European Union), an email delivery service (address verification, password reset, newsletter) and an analytics tool (only if you accept it). Each receives only the data strictly necessary for its service and is not allowed to use it for other purposes, for advertising, or to train its own models. Your documents, conversations and the associated vector index are hosted and processed exclusively within the European Union. The email provider, however, may be established outside the European Union: it receives no content from your documents, and the corresponding transfers are governed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses. The current, named list of these processors is available on request via the contact form.

sections.title: Data controller and retention periods
sections.body: The data controller is the publisher of the service, whose full identity appears on the Legal notice page; they can be reached through the contact form. Your account data, documents and conversations are kept for as long as your account exists, then deleted as soon as you delete your account. Messages sent through the contact form are kept for the time needed to handle your request. A newsletter subscription is kept until you unsubscribe.

sections.title: Your rights (GDPR)
sections.body: Export your data: from My Account, download a file with all of your data in one click. Delete your account: from My Account (danger zone), immediate and permanent deletion of your account and workspaces. Newsletter: every email includes a one-click unsubscribe link, no login required. For any other request (rectification, objection), use the contact form.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: By creating an account or using {{brand}}, you agree to the rules below. They're meant to stay simple and readable.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.body: These terms govern access to and use of {{brand}} (the "Service"), an application for uploading documents into workspaces and querying them through an AI-based conversational assistant. Using the Service means fully accepting these terms.

sections.title: 2. User account
sections.body: Using the Service requires creating an account (email/password, or sign-in via a third-party provider such as Google). You're responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity carried out from your account. An account is personal and must not be shared.

sections.title: 3. Uploaded content
sections.body: You remain the owner of the documents you upload. You warrant that you hold the necessary rights over any imported content and are responsible for its lawfulness. This content is used only to answer your own questions within your workspaces - it is never used to train an AI model, nor shared with other users without your explicit action (a share link).

sections.title: 4. Workspaces and sharing
sections.body: Each workspace belongs to an owner, who may invite other users via a share link (read-only or read/write depending on the chosen role). The owner of a workspace is responsible for the people they invite and the content uploaded there. The number of workspaces, members per workspace, storage and questions per day are limited per account (see the Pricing page).

sections.title: 5. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to use the Service to upload or generate unlawful content, not to attempt to circumvent technical limits (quotas, rate limiting, security measures), and not to disrupt the Service for other users. Any breach may result in account suspension or deletion.

sections.title: 6. Limits of the AI
sections.body: Responses generated by the AI assistant may be incomplete, inaccurate, or contain errors (hallucinations), even when citing sources. They are in no way professional, legal, medical, or financial advice. You remain solely responsible for how you use the responses provided.

sections.title: 7. Free service and usage limits
sections.body: The service is entirely free: no subscription or payment is ever required. To ensure fair use and prevent abuse, each account is subject to usage limits (workspaces, members per workspace, storage, questions asked to the AI per day), shown on the Pricing page and subject to change. Circumventing these limits (for example by creating multiple accounts) may lead to the suspension of the accounts involved. You can delete your account at any time, which permanently deletes your workspaces and associated data.

sections.title: 8. Service availability
sections.body: The Service is provided as-is, with an availability target but no guarantee of absolute continuity. Temporary interruptions (maintenance, technical incidents) may occur. Automatic backups reduce, without eliminating, the risk of data loss.

sections.title: 9. Changes to these terms
sections.body: These terms may evolve, notably to reflect new features or legal obligations. Users will be informed of any significant change via the application or by email. Continued use of the Service after notice constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

sections.title: 10. Governing law and contact
sections.body: These terms are governed by French law. For any question, use the site's contact form.

items.question: What is {{brand}}?
items.answer: {{brand}} connects your business documents (PDF, images, web pages, DOCX, TXT, Markdown) to an AI with sourced answers, in spaces siloed per client or file. Built for firms, agencies and teams managing multiple clients.

items.question: Do I need an account to use it?
items.answer: Yes, a free account is required to use {{brand}}, including to open a share link. That's what lets each space know exactly who accessed it and with which role.

items.question: What is a workspace?
items.answer: A workspace groups documents and conversations around a given topic. Each workspace is isolated: nothing is shared between two different spaces. Several people can collaborate on the same workspace.

items.question: What roles exist on a workspace?
items.answer: Owner (creates the space, manages members and share links, can delete it), editor (can chat with the assistant and add documents), and viewer (can only browse history and documents, without writing).

items.question: How do share links work?
items.answer: From a space you own, generate a link with the viewer or editor role. Anyone signed in who opens that link gets access to the space with that role - if they don't have an account yet, they're prompted to create one for free first. You can revoke a link at any time.

items.question: Which document formats are supported?
items.answer: PDF (native text or scanned, with automatic OCR by a vision AI), images (JPG, PNG, WEBP...), web pages, DOCX, TXT and Markdown. Documents are automatically chunked and indexed for search.

items.question: Can the AI search the web?
items.answer: Yes. When a question needs current information (news, weather, prices...), the assistant automatically detects the need and completes its answer via a self-hosted search engine, with no API key and no tracking.

items.question: Does my data stay private?
items.answer: Yes, within the European Union. Your documents, embeddings and conversations are stored on our servers in France, at OVHcloud. To generate an answer, the relevant text is sent to Mistral AI, a French publisher whose processing takes place in the EU - nothing goes to a provider outside the European Union, and your data is never used to train a model. Audio transcription does not even leave our servers.

items.question: How do I enable two-factor verification (2FA)?
items.answer: From the Account page, Security section, click Enable next to "Two-factor verification". Scan the code with your authenticator app, then confirm with the 6-digit code.

items.question: What happens if I delete a document or conversation by mistake?
items.answer: Every workspace gets an automatic backup (at most once a day, kept on a 7-day rolling window). An instance administrator can restore the space to an earlier state from the admin dashboard.

items.question: How much does {{brand}} cost?
items.answer: {{brand}} is entirely free, with no credit card and no subscription. To prevent abuse, each account has usage limits: 3 workspaces, 5 members per workspace, 500 MB of storage per workspace and 50 AI questions per day.
